LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 10.1.1 ORAL PRESENTATIONS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.1: Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can you make a speech presentation interesting? 2. What are some of the techniques for introducing or concluding a speech?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration is inculcated as the learners work in groups to discuss the format of a speech.

• Learning to learn is developed as learners organise their own learning and acquire speech presentation skills.

Values:
• Respect is enhanced as the learner listens to peers speeches and respect each other’s opinions.

• Unity is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers while engaging in conversations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Social cohesion is improved as the learner are presenting a speech on art thus making learners appreciate their heritage

Link to other subjects:

Public speaking is a concept relevant in performance of various genres in Creative Arts.
